name: cadcraft
description: Create, open and edit DXF/DWG CAD drawings with CADCraft, an open-source CAD engine that runs on this computer.

interface.longDescription: CADCraft creates and edits DXF and DWG drawings on this computer: floor plans, site plans, parts and details with layers, dimensions, text, hatches and blocks. It opens drawings from anywhere on the computer, finds a drawing you drop into the chat by name, saves new drawings in Documents/CADCraft, and renders a picture to check the result.
defaultPrompt: Draw a 10 by 6 metre two-room floor plan with dimensions
Open my drawing and list its layers
Add a title block to this drawing
